#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <limits>

int main() {
    int length;
    std::cin >> length;
    std::cin.ignore(std::numeric_limits<std::streamsize>::max(), '\n');
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);

    int maxLength = 0;
    int currentLength = 0;
    int wordCount = 0;
    int insideWordLength = 0;
    int parenthesisDepth = 0;
    bool hasOutsideLetter = false;
    bool hasInsideLetter = false;
    bool inside = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        bool isLeftParen = (c == '(');
        bool isRightParen = (c == ')');

        if (isLeftParen) {
            inside = true;
            parenthesisDepth++;
            if (maxLength < currentLength) maxLength = currentLength;
            currentLength = 0;
            hasOutsideLetter = false;
        } else if (isRightParen) {
            inside = false;
            parenthesisDepth = 0;
            if (insideWordLength > 0) {
                wordCount++;
                insideWordLength = 0;
            }
        } else {
            if (parenthesisDepth > 0) inside = true;
        }

        if (!isLeftParen && !isRightParen) {
            if (!inside) {
                if (c == '_') {
                    if (maxLength < currentLength) maxLength = currentLength;
                    currentLength = 0;
                    hasOutsideLetter = false;
                } else {
                    hasOutsideLetter = true;
                }
                if (hasOutsideLetter) currentLength++;
            } else {
                hasOutsideLetter = false;
                if (c == '_') {
                    if (insideWordLength > 0) wordCount++;
                    insideWordLength = 0;
                    hasInsideLetter = false;
                } else {
                    hasInsideLetter = true;
                }
                if (hasInsideLetter) insideWordLength++;
            }
        }
    }

    if (maxLength < currentLength) maxLength = currentLength;
    std::cout << maxLength << " " << wordCount << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
